threshold_policy.mapping_note: /shop has ONE canonical 100-point article score (no separate SEO score). The owner-approved 75/70/75 production thresholds map onto it as follows: QUALITY_MIN = 75 = thresholds.PASS.min (a publishable article must score >= 75 with no critical failures); SEO_MIN = 70 = thresholds.REVIEW.min (the floor below which even REVIEW is refused: 0-69 = FAIL; the SEO dimension is carried inside the total score by the technical_seo/search_intent/schema_metadata sections, which are hard-failing on critical SEO defects such as missing/mismatched canonical, duplicate slug/canonical and schema errors); PUBLISH_MIN = 75 = the same PASS.min, enforced by scripts/js/factory.mjs --publish and --qa-record (both read it from THIS file - no hardcoded magic numbers). Scores 75-100 are simply PASS when there are no critical failures. There is no EXCELLENT tier and no QA warning score band. Any critical failure is FAIL regardless of score (score 100 included).

article_length.legacy_note: The LEGACY band (target_*/review_* above) applies ONLY to rows genuinely published before legacy_published_before (the pre-cutover corpus). NEVER key the band on status=PUBLISHED: a new article keeps the unpublished_* band (1500-5000) for its whole life - QA -> publish -> post-publish gate - so the standard can never flip under a running pair.

critical_failure_rules: fixed price invented for unknown model
malformed HTML/front matter that prevents rendering
unsupported legal claim in requires_sources article without source evidence
production article with zero contextual internal links

notes.keyword_density: NOT USED. No arbitrary density thresholds; only obvious stuffing/duplication is detected.
notes.word_count: Mr Tú Content Factory production standard, counted from the article MAIN CONTENT only (article/main container minus navigation, header, footer, breadcrumb, chatbot, scripts, styles, JSON-LD; words = whitespace-separated Vietnamese tokens of the remaining text). This is an internal editorial standard — NOT a Google requirement. NOT-YET-PUBLISHED rows (WRITING/PASS/REPAIR/REVIEW/FAIL/BLOCKED): target 1,500–5,000 words = satisfied; 1,100–1,499 or 5,001–5,400 = REVIEW; <1,100 or >5,400 = FAIL. Choose the length inside the band by search intent — never force every article to 5,000. ALREADY-PUBLISHED rows keep the LEGACY band: 1,600–2,000 satisfied; 1,200–1,599 or 2,001–2,300 REVIEW; <1,200 or >2,300 FAIL — published articles are never re-audited against the new band. Padding is never rewarded: repeated sentences/paragraphs, duplicate sections, keyword stuffing and filler are detected separately. SAMPLE/compact test fixtures are exempt.
notes.contextual_internal_links: Every production article must contain 3–8 contextual internal links inside the editorial body (menu, footer, breadcrumb, logo, chatbot, pagination, social and external links never count). Exactly one link to the article's parent category hub is required; at most 1 contextual commercial landing-page link by default. Anchors must describe their destination; generic anchors and repeated exact-match anchors are flagged.
notes.legal_content: Articles covering law/fines/licence/insurance with requires_sources=true must include a source/reference section; otherwise REVIEW or FAIL.
